label: Metastatic triple-negative, germline BRCA1, recurred after neoadjuvant pembrolizumab
summary: 41-year-old premenopausal woman with triple-negative breast cancer (ER 0%, PR 0%, HER2 IHC 0). Germline BRCA1 pathogenic variant. Diagnosed with stage IIB disease in January 2024; received neoadjuvant carboplatin/paclitaxel + pembrolizumab followed by AC + pembrolizumab, then mastectomy with residual disease (not a pathologic complete response), followed by adjuvant capecitabine and completion of pembrolizumab in March 2025. In September 2026 found to have multiple lung nodules; biopsy confirmed recurrent TNBC. PD-L1 CPS 15. No treatment yet for metastatic disease. Brain MRI October 2026: no brain metastases. ECOG 0. Labs normal. No autoimmune disease; had grade 2 hypothyroidism from pembrolizumab, now on levothyroxine.

missing_information: organ function labs (such as bilirubin, AST, ALT, creatinine, absolute neutrophil count, platelets, hemoglobin) beyond stating 'Labs normal'
